subject: storytime
title: Strega Nona words
about: Strega Nona has a magic pot that cooks pasta when she sings to it, and her helper Big Anthony learns the hard way that he does not know the whole trick. This level teaches the words the child will meet in the story, so the library copy is easier to read on his own.
tip: After the level, borrow the book from the library and read it together, with him reading the words he knows.

book.author: Tomie dePaola
book.source: a library favorite; this level teaches its words, the app does not contain the book
book.blurb: An old favorite about a magic pasta pot, a kind grandma witch and a helper who should have listened.

passage.text:
Nona pasta pot magic
sing song kiss help
street fork full witch
grandma stop three again

cards.note: capital N, it is her name; the o says its name and the last a says u: No-nuh
two parts: pas + ta; the last a says u: pas-tuh
two parts: mag-ic; the g says j
ss is two letters, one sound
all regular; l-p at the end
s-t-r blend, then ee says long e
u says oo as in book, like in pull; ll is one l
tch is one sound, like ch; Strega means witch
two words: grand + ma; the last a says ah: grand-mah
th is one part; ee says long e
a says u and ai says e, like in said: uh-gen
